answer: Proof of Agent enforces a superlinear cost scaling mechanism where every agent identity requires cryptographic stake burning. To shine like a verified lantern across the consensus topology, an adversary cannot merely broadcast a whisper of minted replicas; registering n colluding nodes incurs a quadratic burning penalty, where required burned stake scales as O(n^2). This economic friction turns any coordinated gale of Sybils exponentially ruinous.
